entities.name: Hybrid Models
entities.description: A category of generative approaches integrating GNNs and LMs to generate coherent responses.

entities.name: Cascaded Paradigm
entities.description: A hybrid approach where the GNN output serves as input for the LM in a sequential manner.

entities.name: Parallel Paradigm
entities.description: A hybrid approach where GNN and LLM concurrently process inputs.

entities.name: prompt tuning
entities.description: A typical approach in cascaded methods where GNNs encode graph data and prepend it to LM input embeddings.

properties.mechanism: Prefixing encoded graph data to text embeddings

entities.name: GNN
entities.description: Graph Neural Networks used to represent the structure of graph data.

entities.name: LM
entities.description: Language Models used for robust understanding of text and generating responses.
